one_sentence: All bibliographic facts (title, authors, journal, volume/issue, pages, year, publisher) check out against CrossRef, but the title's technical capitals N and T are unprotected and will be lowercased by BibTeX, and the entry has no DOI; note this entry is not cited anywhere in paper_anpec.tex.

issues.original: Consistent estimation of the number of dynamic factors in a large N and T panel
issues.corrected: Consistent estimation of the number of dynamic factors in a large {N} and {T} panel
issues.reason: N and T are technical notation (cross-section and time-series dimensions), not ordinary words. Standard .bst styles lowercase non-initial, unbraced capitals, which would silently turn 'N and T' into 'n and t' and obscure the meaning. Verified against CrossRef title 'Consistent Estimation of the Number of Dynamic Factors in a Large N and T Panel' (title case there, but the capitalization convention in the entry's own sentence case still requires braces around N and T).
No DOI field present. CrossRef confirms DOI 10.1198/073500106000000585 for this article; adding it gives a stable canonical anchor and is standard BibTeX hygiene.

Verified correct, not an error. CrossRef lists the registrant as 'Informa UK Limited', which is the corporate parent operating as Taylor & Francis (JBES's publisher; the American Statistical Association is the sponsoring society, not the publisher of record). No change needed.
